---
name: Skill Improvement
about: Suggest an improvement to an existing skill
title: "fix(SKILL-NAME): "
labels: improvement
---

## Skill

Which skill? (e.g., `cold-email`, `discovery-call`)

## What's wrong

Describe the current behavior or content that needs improvement.

## Suggested change

What should it say/do instead? Be specific — include example text, frameworks, or templates if possible.

## Why

Why is this change better? Reference real-world sales experience if applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I've read the skill I'm suggesting changes to
- [ ] My suggestion is based on practitioner experience, not textbook theory
- [ ] I've checked that this doesn't duplicate another skill's responsibility
